observations: The new s0L has a visible but modest left-hand pose change toward robot reference endpoint 0; the right hand and both objects begin in the same rendered poses.
No gross new interpenetration is visually apparent in the reviewed collision overlays; formal legality is determined by the float64 and runtime-float32 native gates, not by rendering.
Differences during the first control cycle and endpoints 1-10 are subtle and do not support a claim of uniformly better early tray position tracking.

At endpoints 14-20, and especially endpoint 20 in the top view, LEFT_ALIGNED_REPLAY is visibly closer to the reference tray pose than ORIGINAL, consistent with the measured position and rotation errors.
The skipped HOLD panels correctly disclose that the new initial control cannot be encoded inside the frozen residual support.
adjudication: Visual evidence supports a mixed early response and a clearer endpoint-20 improvement; it does not establish a deployable reset or full-task feasibility.
